general.notes: Product is a BiDi pair: SO-SFP-MR25-BX20D-34 (TX 1270–1350 nm / RX 1440–1540 nm per footnote 1) and SO-SFP-MR25-BX20D-43 (TX 1470–1510 nm / RX 1260–1360 nm per footnote 2). Overview states 1310 nm and 1490 nm respectively. Transmit output power and receiver min/overload are average power (footnote 3). Receiver minimum input power and overload apply at BER ≤ 1×10⁻¹², back-to-back (footnote 4). Summary column lists power budget 3–13 dB and dispersion penalty Max 1 dB without further numeric dispersion tolerance. Storage temperature -40°C to +85°C stated separately from operating 0°C to +70°C. Power consumption stated as < 1.0 W.
